title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments acr

translated_title: FVScore：规格驱动的神经符号视频评估
translated_abstract: 我们提出了忠实性视频评分（FVSCORE），这是一个用于规格驱动视频生成评估的神经符号框架。现有的评估器依赖于整体性的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）判断或视觉-语言指标，然而如何使这些评分与人类判断保持一致，并将其追溯到具体的时间性违规，仍然是悬而未决的挑战。FVSCORE 通过将每个视频编译为显式命题（捕捉提示词要求）和隐式命题（捕捉未明说的物理、时间及跨模态约束）来解决上述局限。它使用专门的感知工具为每个命题提供依据，并用受线性时序逻辑启发的软时序算子评估由此产生的置信度轨迹。随后，显著性感知校准步骤通过仅保留感知上显著的违规，使验证结果与人类感知保持一致，最终生成带有时间戳和证据支撑的报告。我们在……上进行了大量实验（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: FVSCORE 提出了一种规格驱动的神经符号视频生成评估框架，通过将视频分解为显式与隐式命题、借助专用感知工具和时序逻辑软算子进行验证，并经显著性感知校准对齐人类感知，最终生成可追溯、有证据支撑的评估报告。
en_tdlr: FVSCORE is a neuro-symbolic, specification-driven framework for video generation evaluation that decomposes videos into explicit and implicit propositions, verifies them with specialized perceptual tools and soft temporal logic operators, and applies significance-aware calibration to produce timestamped, evidence-grounded judgments aligned with human perception.
